module_name: Aerial Path — The Vigil of the Blight (besm_aradia Starter)

node_01_vale.title: Vale of Thorns — Sabaoth Encampment
node_01_vale.description: The Council of Aeons' green, a Sabaoth hunting encampment on the Vale's edge. Winged Asrai muster beneath the Tiara of Aradia; the Oracles read the storm-symbols. Beyond the treeline, the Wormwood Blight's horizon smolders.

node_02_oath.title: The Vigil of the Wind
node_02_oath.description: Before the hunt, you swear the Vigil to the Oracles of the Wind — a soul-checking oath binding the Sabaoth to protect the Living Heaven and destroy the tainted. Break it, and the Blight has already won a hunter.

node_03_storm.title: The Storm-Symbols
node_03_storm.description: The Wisdom of Aradia rises as a storm overhead — the planet reading you as you fly. Read the storm-symbols true, and the wind carries you; misread them, and the Living Heaven flings you back toward the Vale.

node_04_whirl.title: The Whirl — Gate to Earth
node_04_whirl.description: The Whirl spins in the ocean — Aradia's natural dimensional gate to Earth, humming with the Cosmic Web. A lost angel's egg drifts on its edge. And the Blight's seed is reaching for it.

node_05_blight.title: Wormwood Blight's Edge
node_05_blight.description: The cancer valley's edge — cannibal unicorns, dark fairies, wyverns under a sick green sky. The tainted fairy Mothwing is somewhere in here, and the Blight wants to reach the Whirl. A brutal body-check as the corrupted wildlife closes.

node_06_haven.title: The Tainted Haven
node_06_haven.description: Mothwing's haven — a glade the Blight hasn't yet consumed, holding a seed of the cancer and a small cache of the Living Heaven's gifts. The Vigil ends here: redeem the fairy, or let the Blight take its prize.
